描述_EN: small carved boxes of this type represent a popular item during the 16th century; they were generally decorated with flowers, but landscapes, figures and fruits were also used on a few examples. this box was made of successive layers of lacquer applied to a wooden core, and subsequently carved with fine details. this technique was completely established by the 15th century, during the early ming dynasty (1368-1644).
